dataset_taxonomy.description: Basic perception of entities, attributes, and short-lived visual evidence despite blur, short appearances, and unstable viewpoints.

sub_categories.name: Object Existence
sub_categories.description: Identify whether a specific object exists in the current frame despite unstable viewpoints.

sub_categories.name: Counting QA
sub_categories.description: Evaluate small-range counting of pedestrians or objects under clutter and shake, which is harder than in stable videos.

sub_categories.name: Visual Attributes
sub_categories.description: Recognize visible properties (e.g., color, shape) of entities despite blur and short appearances.

sub_categories.name: Scene and Place QA
sub_categories.description: Target coarse environment understanding such as identifying a sidewalk, park path, crossing, residential street, or main road.

sub_categories.name: Negative or Absence QA
sub_categories.description: Useful for hallucination analysis by asking whether a specific object (e.g., a bicycle) is present at all when it is not.

dataset_taxonomy.description: Recognition of human, vehicle, and ego actions under motion-heavy conditions.

sub_categories.name: Ego-action Recognition
sub_categories.description: Focuses on what the runner (or ego-subject) is doing at a moment or across a short segment.

sub_categories.name: Pedestrian and Cyclist Action
sub_categories.description: Identify what pedestrians, cyclists, or other active human subjects are doing in the scene.

sub_categories.name: Vehicle and Agent Action
sub_categories.description: Recognize the movement or state of vehicles (e.g., cars, buses) interacting with the environment.

dataset_taxonomy.description: Ordering, transitions, memory, and event localization over time.

sub_categories.name: Event Sequencing
sub_categories.description: Requires understanding event order (e.g., did an event happen before or after passing a landmark).

sub_categories.name: Event Memory QA
sub_categories.description: Tests recall of something seen earlier in the clip after camera motion and scene changes.

sub_categories.name: Action Repetition
sub_categories.description: Reason about repetitions of specific actions or events across time.

sub_categories.name: State Transitions
sub_categories.description: Track how the state of the environment or objects changes over a specific time segment.

dataset_taxonomy.description: Joint reasoning over video content and route traces.

sub_categories.name: Trajectory-grounded QA
sub_categories.description: Combines video with recorded routes to test turn awareness, route stage, loops, or visual-trajectory alignment.

sub_categories.name: Spatial Relation QA
sub_categories.description: Checks whether the model understands left/right, front/behind, near/far, and object-to-object relations within unstable scenes.

sub_categories.name: Ego-motion Navigation
sub_categories.description: Determine if the runner is moving along a straight segment or making a turn.

dataset_taxonomy.description: Performance under shake, blur, occlusion, darkness, glare, and ambiguity.

sub_categories.name: Day-vs-night Robustness QA
sub_categories.description: Measures whether the model remains reliable under low light, glare, shadows, and reduced visibility.

sub_categories.name: Ambiguity-aware QA
sub_categories.description: Allows the correct output to be uncertainty rather than a forced answer when evidence is too blurred or incomplete.

sub_categories.name: Unanswerable / Insufficient Evidence QA
sub_categories.description: Evaluates if the model correctly responds with 'insufficient evidence' instead of hallucinating when clip data is completely missing or unidentifiable due to severe motion.
